# Rodrigo Bondioli

> Creative Director in São Paulo, Brazil, with 20+ years across agencies, retail and his own business. Former head of design at Netshoes and Americanas.com. He helps decide what's worth building, then builds it: brand, product and interface.

The site is in English at the root and in Brazilian Portuguese under /pt. The full portfolio, with every project, is available as a single Markdown file.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio in Markdown](https://rodrigobondioli.com/portfolio.md): every project, services and contact in one file
- [Work](https://rodrigobondioli.com/work): selected work, opening with the Tattoaria case study
- [Tattoaria case study](https://rodrigobondioli.com/projects/tattoaria): the rotating tattoo studio he founded and ran, 2015–2020

## About

- [Info](https://rodrigobondioli.com/info): his story, experience, awards, teaching and brands
- [Contact](https://rodrigobondioli.com/contact): hello@rodrigobondioli.com
